title: Painting — School of Art, University of Tennessee
description: In 1971, Craig was enrolled in the School of Art at the University of Tennessee, where he took a course in cinematography. He later left school to work as a gaffer on Together for Days (1972, dir. Michael Schultz), filmed in Atlanta in fall 1971 at Storer Studios — the feature film debut of both Lois Chiles and Samuel L. Jackson, also starring Clifton Davis. Realizing art would not yield a stable living, he took a job as a draftsman and returned to school to earn a degree in architecture.
